name: Parc de la Récréation
coreDecision: Historical outdoor park at Le Petit Nétilly in Monts, parking across Sorigny boundary. National backlog expressly separates historical La Récréation from successor Family Park, whose existing public record 2f436a73-8a36-4adc-9723-f14d569ed4f8 remains untouched. All six aliases searched globally in Parks and Standalone including both Family Park result pages; no separate historical record found. Municipal May2018 PLU and October2018 council record confirm site occupation since1994 and closure2018; contemporary July2017 press says27years (implying1990), so first opening year left unresolved rather than equating implantation and foundation. Exact source point47.2612921,0.6719202 from archived official2016 access map, consistent with PLU location; malformed printed longitude and town-centre directory point rejected. Last operator LA RECREATION, RCS TOURS451133516, established by archived official legal notice; no founder attribution. No live website because old domain repurposed; no current hours/prices. Historical logo native file recovered from local lodging tourism page; import follows. Private ToReview.

dateConflict.decision: Leave original opening date blank; site-implantation fact1994 can be narrated with source attribution.

zonesDecision: No official named zones proven; no fabricated subdivision.
